en: A black‑and‑white view of a hilltop complex with two tall, narrow, pointed-roof towers, likely part of a castle or fortified church, seen from a wooded slope in the foreground. Leafy trees and bushes frame the scene, partially obscuring several smaller buildings below the main structure. The sky is overexposed in the upper left, creating a large white patch. Along the very top edge there appears to be faint handwritten or printed numbering or notes in white.
